63121ef3c35571a6.description: About alfanar Electric alfanar, headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is a diversified company with operations in construction, manufacturing, design, and development across the Middle East and other countries. The company is active in Electrical, Electromechanical, and Civil Engineering Construction, manufacturing and marketing electrical construction products, and providing allied engineering services. alfanar Electric serves as the industrial arm of alfanar, specializing in the manufacturing of low, medium, and high voltage electrical construction products. Its industrial facilities are located in Riyadh and Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia; Dubai, UAE; and London, UK. alfanar also maintains a development and engineering center in Chennai, India. The primary hub for alfanar’s industrial activities is the alfanar Industrial Complex in Riyadh, spanning 700,000 square meters and housing comprehensive infrastructure. Role Overview alfanar Electric is seeking a Sr. HSE Engineer to provide advanced technical support for Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) across assigned areas. This full-time role involves conducting risk assessments, performing inspections, investigating incidents, and verifying operational controls during day or night shifts. The Sr. HSE Engineer will contribute to strengthening compliance, emergency readiness, and technical competency through guidance, analysis, and effective shift handover processes in Riyadh and Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia. The position requires 6-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Conduct complex risk assessments, including ATEX/hazardous-area classification, machinery safety, chemical exposure, and fire risks, and develop appropriate assessment methodologies. Review assessments prepared by engineers and inspectors, verifying the adequacy of proposed mitigation measures. Assess HSE controls for contractor activities, maintenance, shutdowns, projects, and production line modifications. Support occupational exposure assessments and verify environmental controls for chemicals, waste, and spill prevention. Develop inspection schedules and conduct planned patrols of high-risk areas during assigned shifts, providing technical guidance on inspection priorities. Participate in cross-factory audits and conduct ISO 45001/14001 internal audits as assigned. Verify permit-to-work, hot work, and lockout/tagout compliance for operational, maintenance, and contractor activities, identifying deviations from approved procedures. Verify valid third-party certification of regulated equipment and required operator licenses, exercising stop-work authority when unsafe conditions present unacceptable risk. Investigate serious and high-potential incidents using advanced root cause analysis methods and recommend actions to address underlying causes. Provide immediate incident response, coordinate with emergency teams, secure the scene for investigation, and escalate serious incidents to the HSE Manager without delay. Maintain area emergency response arrangements and participate in drills aligned with Civil Defense requirements. Coach engineers and inspectors, contribute to competency assessments, and develop structured technical development plans. Develop training materials and deliver awareness campaigns, toolbox talks, and technical training, including for permit issuers and receivers. Develop improvements to inspection methods, digital reporting, and operational controls, benchmarking good practices and measuring their impact. Analyze HSE findings, incident trends, and KPIs, presenting findings and technical recommendations to stakeholders. Track corrective actions through closure and verify their effectiveness. Prepare shift HSE reports and manage handover of incidents, significant risks, and outstanding actions between day and night teams to ensure continuity of HSE coverage. Accountabilities and Compliance Maintain updated soft and technical skills relevant to the job. Perform planned activities to meet operational and development targets as per delivery schedules, utilizing resources effectively within cost and time constraints. Provide periodic reports detailing deviations and execution of planned tasks. Solve related problems and escalate complex operational issues. Ensure quality requirements are met to develop effective quality control and processes, including specifications for products, processes, or related activities. Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automation opportunities. Comply with relevant policies, procedures, and work instructions. Ensure compliance with relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within the defined area of work activity. Experience and Work Type This is a full-time position requiring 6-10 years of experience in a relevant HSE role. The successful candidate will be based in either Riyadh or Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia, and will be expected to work day or night shifts as assigned to ensure continuous HSE coverage.

636bb794859922a7.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المدينه المنوره لنقل الحجاج عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان نقل الحجاج والمعتمرين والزوار بأمان وفعالية، مع الالتزام بالمسارات والجداول الزمنية المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى سائق الشاحنة الصغيرة مسؤولية قيادة المركبة بأمان والالتزام بالتعليمات التشغيلية، وتشمل مهامه ما يلي: قيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة لنقل الركاب بأمان وفق المسارات والجداول المحددة. التقيد بأنظمة المرور والسرعات المحددة، والقيادة بسلاسة لتجنب التوقف أو التجاوز المفاجئ. الامتناع التام عن استخدام الهاتف الجوال أثناء القيادة وربط حزام الأمان. إجراء الفحص اليومي للشاحنة، بما في ذلك الفرامل والإطارات والأنوار ومستوى الوقود، قبل كل رحلة. التأكد من جاهزية أجهزة السلامة مثل مطفأة الحريق وحقيبة الإسعافات الأولية. الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي أعطال ميكانيكية لمركز الصيانة. الالتزام بجدول الرحلة ومواعيد التوقف والوصول المحددة. استقبال الركاب بأسلوب مهذب وتقديم المساعدة اللازمة، خاصة لكبار السن وذوي الإعاقة. التأكد من مطابقة تذاكر الركاب أو صعود الفئات المصرح لها فقط. الحفاظ على نظافة الشاحنة وتشغيل التكييف والإضاءة المناسبة لضمان بيئة مريحة. تفقد الشاحنة بعد كل رحلة للتأكد من خلوها من الركاب والتعامل مع المفقودات. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة أو الحافلات. معرفة جيدة بأنظمة المرور والسلامة على الطرق. القدرة على التعامل مع الركاب بأسلوب مهذب واحترافي. الالتزام بالمواعيد والجداول الزمنية. القدرة على إجراء الفحوصات الأساسية للمركبة والإبلاغ عن الأعطال. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة المدينه المنوره لنقل الحجاج. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

63971b8162cd4fa0.description: About Rackspace Technology Rackspace Technology™ is a leading provider of end-to-end hybrid cloud and AI solutions. The company designs, builds, and operates cloud and AI environments for customers across major technology platforms, independent of technology stack or deployment model. Rackspace Technology partners with customers throughout their cloud and AI journey to enable application modernization, AI adoption, innovation, and business transformation. Recognized by Glassdoor, Newsweek, and Forbes as a top employer, the company focuses on attracting and developing talent committed to delivering its Fanatical Experience™. Role Overview The Senior Sales Executive specializes in identifying, developing, and closing opportunities with new and existing customers to drive profitable growth and achieve customer outcomes. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involves managing the complete sales cycle, from new customer acquisition to expanding strategic relationships and increasing share of wallet within existing accounts. The successful candidate will build and manage executive-level customer relationships, collaborating with technical, delivery, and business stakeholders to develop solutions for complex business challenges. This is a consultative, hunter-oriented role requiring proactive opportunity creation and pipeline development, engaging senior decision-makers within enterprise organizations. Success will be measured by generating net-new business, building a sustainable pipeline, consistently exceeding revenue targets, and establishing Rackspace as a strategic partner in key enterprise accounts. Key Responsibilities Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, close, and ongoing account growth. Develop and execute account plans, including pursuit strategies, timelines, deliverables, and revenue objectives for assigned accounts. Maintain a territory and portfolio strategy that prioritizes high-value opportunities. Identify and develop new business opportunities through proactive outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, and partner engagement. Collaborate with Marketing and Business Development Representatives (BDRs) on targeted campaigns and sales plays. Lead the sales process across the Rackspace solutions portfolio. Build relationships with key stakeholders and executive decision-makers within target accounts. Qualify customer opportunities, identify business drivers, and align Rackspace solutions with customer objectives. Conduct discovery sessions to understand customer challenges, priorities, and transformation goals. Partner with Sales Engineers and technical specialists to assess customer environments and define solution strategies. Develop compelling proposals, business cases, and value propositions. Lead negotiations, contract discussions, renewals, and commercial reviews. Drive strategic pursuits aligned with territorial objectives and company growth strategy. Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Delivery, Support, Customer Success, and Partner teams. Proactively identify and resolve obstacles impacting sales opportunities and customer success. Build and maintain a robust pipeline to consistently achieve and exceed quota. Represent Rackspace at executive meetings, industry events, partner engagements, and customer workshops. Required Experience and Qualifications 5-10 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in technology, cloud, managed services, AI, data, or digital transformation. Demonstrated track record of generating net-new pipeline and acquiring new enterprise customers. Proven experience selling cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or digital transformation solutions. Credibility in engaging C-level executives and senior business stakeholders. Evidence of personally creating opportunities rather than relying primarily on inbound demand. Strong ability to connect technology investments to tangible business, financial, and operational outcomes. Experience managing complex, consultative enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Strong executive presence, commercial acumen, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Demonstrated success selling high-value, multi-year managed services or transformation engagements. Experience working within multinational, matrixed organizations and coordinating resources across multiple functions. Self-starter mentality with a strong bias for action, resilience, and a proven hunting mindset.

Key Responsibilities Conduct regular visits to physicians, including dermatologists, pediatricians, and general practitioners, to create demand for Ego brands through product detailing and professional selling techniques. 63b1d48d904834bd.description: About the Role SuperAnnotate is seeking a Kannada Linguistic QA Specialist for a remote, contract position in Saudi Arabia. This role involves overseeing quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Kannada AI training projects as a Kannada Quality Assurance Lead (QAL). The specialist will review AI-generated Kannada content and trainer/QA work, evaluating output quality against project guidelines and providing precise written feedback. Role Context and Impact This position is with SME Careers, a subsidiary of SuperAnnotate specializing in AI Data Services. The Kannada Quality Assurance Lead will ensure that all contributors adhere to expected quality standards, assessing work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. The role directly contributes to improving AI models by ensuring Kannada training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. Key Responsibilities Quality Monitoring: Spot-check Kannada items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback, and escalate recurring or critical issues. Trainer and QA Communication: Update trainers and QAs on new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. Question Handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, particularly regarding Kannada wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, regional variation, and edge cases. Quality Alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs consistently apply Kannada language guidelines and understand updates as projects evolve. Process Improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Kannada-language projects. Required Skills and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong proficiency in both Kannada and English. Excellent attention to detail. Structured communication skills. Ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. Work Environment This is an hourly, remote contractor role, offering flexibility while requiring consistent engagement to manage quality workflows across distributed teams. The position is based in Saudi Arabia.

63b3627990995bfc.description: About Namaa Partners Namaa Partners is a strategic consulting firm primarily working with entities in Saudi Arabia and companies with significant interests there. The firm was established to address issues that do not fit the large office model, such as a board discussing succession, a family group considering external capital injection, or a holding company that has lost a clear picture of its portfolio economics. The firm's work covers corporate strategy, growth, market entry, operating models, efficiency improvement, organization, talent, digital strategy, performance improvement, governance, and risk. Partners who define the scope of work are involved in its execution, and collaboration with clients often continues beyond the recommendation phase, including attending board meetings and testing management plans during implementation. Data Analysis Specialist Role Namaa Partners is seeking a Data Analysis Specialist to join its team in Riyadh. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. The specialist will play a key role in collecting, organizing, and analyzing client data to support strategic consulting projects. Key Responsibilities Collect client data from various sources, ranging from internal performance reports to sector databases, and clean and organize it for analysis. Prepare tables and charts for presentation materials and board documents, ensuring accuracy of figures before submission. Analyze business, product, and market performance, providing clear interpretations of data to the project team. Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for ongoing projects and regularly update monitoring dashboards. Build simple computational models to estimate the financial impact of various options presented to clients. Document data sources and assumptions used in each analysis for future reference. Required Qualifications and Skills Basic knowledge of data analysis, gained through academic study, training, part-time work, or a university project. Proficiency in using Excel for tables, functions, and charts. Ability to interpret numbers and explain their meaning concisely and clearly. Accuracy in working with numbers, with a habit of reviewing files before submission. Strong organizational skills for arranging files and sources, and documenting work completed. Willingness to learn new analysis tools and dashboards with guidance from the team. Fluency in written and spoken Arabic, and working proficiency in English for reading and correspondence. Preferred Qualifications Practical experience with Power BI or similar tools for building dashboards. Knowledge of SQL or Python fundamentals for data manipulation. Familiarity with sectors in which the company operates, such as family groups, financial services, or government entities. Background in accounting, finance, or business administration. Work Environment and Growth This is a full-time, fully remote position, with tasks performed from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role offers direct involvement in projects for decision-makers within prominent entities in the Kingdom. You will work closely with those who define and execute projects, without multiple management layers separating analysis from decision-making. This provides early exposure to areas such as strategy, growth, operating models, and performance improvement. Successful candidates will be comfortable working with unstructured data, organizing it independently, and communicating findings clearly and concisely. The role requires calmness, organization, and the ability to verify sources, especially as project requirements and priorities may shift. Individuals with these habits will find ample opportunity for practical learning in this role.

639fe76d4126cb09.description: About the Role: Senior Director - Transport Strategy Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Director - Transport Strategy to lead the development and execution of long-term transport and mobility strategies. 63a100f97952dc0e.description: About the Role Chalhoub Group is seeking an Allocator to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring the optimal distribution of inventory and maintaining product availability across retail, e-commerce, and B2B channels. The Allocator will focus on inventory planning, replenishment, and monitoring key performance indicators to support smooth supply chain operations. Key Responsibilities Define and execute initial allocation strategies for seasonal products across stores, aligning with assortment and demand plans. Build and maintain inventory and replenishment plans, considering store space, delivery frequency, and stock requirements. Execute allocation strategies by adapting stock parameters, safety stock, and days of coverage to optimize inventory levels and prevent overstock or stockouts. The role involves collaboration with various internal teams, including retail and supply chain departments, and requires regular store visits.

6331446309f9aa28.job_title: Senior Transport Planner (major urban development project in Riyadh)
6331446309f9aa28.description: Job description Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Position: Senior Transport Planner Experience: Minimum 15 years Industry: Transportation Planning | Urban Development | Infrastructure | Mega Projects Employment Type: Full-time, Project-Based Assignment About the Role We are seeking highly experienced Senior Transport Planners to support a major urban development project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidates will provide specialist transport planning expertise across multiple districts, precincts, and assets within a large-scale master development. Working closely with the client's Transport Planning team, the selected candidates will act as technical advisors, reviewing transport strategies, mobility assessments, and masterplans to ensure alignment with development objectives, applicable standards, and project approval requirements. Key Responsibilities Review and assess Transport Strategies, Transport Masterplans, and Mobility Impact Studies (MIS) at district, precinct, and asset levels. Provide technical reviews and recommendations on transport planning submissions throughout feasibility, concept, preliminary, and detailed design stages. Evaluate road network capacity, transport infrastructure requirements, development phasing, and mobility strategies. Support transport-related Stage Gate approvals, ensuring technical compliance and alignment with project development requirements. Coordinate transport planning activities across district masterplans and individual development assets. Review and validate mobility and land-use assumptions, development statistics, and transport demand requirements. Ensure integration of transport planning solutions with regional mobility strategies and wider urban development objectives. Liaise with multidisciplinary teams, including Road Design, Bridges, Public Realm, Utilities, Transport Modelling, Event Management, and Construction Logistics. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve technical interfaces and facilitate project approvals. Prepare technical assessments, review comments, recommendations, and supporting documentation for governance and approval processes. Contribute to improving transport planning procedures, technical review processes, and lessons learned across development stages. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Transportation Engineering, Civil Engineering, Transport Planning , or a closely related discipline. Master's degree preferred. Minimum 15 years of relevant professional experience in transport planning, including at least 5 years in the Middle East . Demonstrated experience in one or more of the following: Transport masterplanning for large-scale urban developments. Transport and Mobility Impact Assessments. Strategic, mesoscopic, and microscopic transport modelling. Public transport feasibility studies. Road network capacity and traffic impact assessments. Working knowledge of relevant transport planning and modelling tools, including Emme, Cube, SIDRA, Synchro, GIS, and AutoCAD . Sound understanding of applicable Saudi Arabian transport standards and international design guidelines, including AASHTO and DMRB . Familiarity with Manual for Streets, Living Streets , or equivalent street design and mobility planning principles. Proven ability to review complex technical submissions and coordinate across multidisciplinary infrastructure and development teams. Strong analytical, technical reporting, stakeholder management, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Chartered status or professional registration with a recognized engineering or transport planning institution. More than 5 years of professional experience in the Middle East, preferably with substantial experience in Saudi Arabia. Previous experience working in a client-side, developer, or technical advisory role . 635844c8c6852770.description: As a Database Administrator, you ll take ownership of the health and operational reliability of our production databases. You ll work on challenges that go beyond routine administration, including multi-terabyte database environments, high-availability architecture, disaster recovery, major-version upgrades, and safe database migrations. You ll also work closely with engineering, cloud, and reliability teams to help developers make better database decisions, prevent production incidents, and improve the way database changes are designed and delivered. What You ll Do Manage and maintain PostgreSQL and MySQL databases across AWS, GCP, and self-managed environments. Monitor database performance, availability, and capacity. Optimize queries, indexing, and database resource utilization. Manage backups, point-in-time recovery, and disaster recovery. Implement database replication, high availability, and failover strategies. Plan database upgrades, migrations, and safe schema changes. Maintain database security, access controls, and auditing. Automate database operations using Bash, Python, or similar tools. Troubleshoot database incidents and perform root-cause analysis. Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, SRE, and Cloud teams to improve database reliability and scalability. You ve identified the most significant risks and improvement opportunities across availability, performance, backup, and recovery. By day 60: You re independently handling assigned database administration and troubleshooting activities. You ve reviewed backup configurations and started validating recovery procedures for critical databases. You ve identified gaps in database monitoring and alerting, including replication lag, WAL contention, autovacuum, and table bloat. You re contributing to database performance improvements and operational documentation. By day 90: Critical database restore tests have been completed or are progressing against an agreed recovery-testing plan, with gaps documented and corrective actions defined. Key database failure scenarios are documented through practical runbooks. Database monitoring and alerting improvements have been implemented for prioritized operational risks. You re actively contributing to database reliability, performance, and incident-prevention initiatives. By day 120: A safer database change-management process is in place, including appropriate reviews, DDL auditing, and rollback planning. A practical PostgreSQL major-upgrade roadmap has been developed, with compatibility and migration risks assessed. The high-availability approach for the SITE database environment has been evaluated and documented. Database size and activity metrics are available to support the per-customer cost-allocation initiative. Familiarity with database observability, capacity planning, and per-customer database usage or cost allocation. Experience working in SaaS, data-platform, fintech, banking, or telecommunications environments. Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools and automated database provisioning. Relevant certifications, such as EDB PostgreSQL or AWS certifications. What the hiring process will look like Mawhub screening Technical screen (45 min) [DB Lead] Technical deep-dive (60 90 min) with a practical scenario: diagnosing replication lag and WAL contention, planning a zero-downtime major upgrade [DB Lead + SRE Team Lead] Hiring manager interview Mahmoud Moharam, Cloud Manager Culture fit interview - HR Director Desired Candidate Profile Who You Are You re an experienced Database Administrator who understands that managing production databases is about more than keeping services running. You know how to prevent data loss, diagnose complex performance problems, plan high-risk changes, and build systems that remain reliable under pressure. You re comfortable working with large, business-critical databases and can balance operational stability with the need to improve architecture, automation, and scalability. Technically, you likely: Have 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration experience in production. Have experience with AWS Aurora, Amazon RDS, MySQL, and self-managed Linux databases. Understand database performance tuning, replication, high availability, and disaster recovery. Have experience managing multi-terabyte databases, upgrades, and migrations. Can automate database operations using Bash or Python. When it comes to database resilience: You have hands-on experience with backups, recovery, replication, and failover. You can troubleshoot database incidents and minimize downtime. You follow safe change-management practices and maintain rollback plans. When it comes to database performance: You can troubleshoot slow queries, indexing, locking, and resource utilization. You understand PostgreSQL internals and multi-tenant database challenges. What sets you apart: You take ownership and remain calm under pressure. You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. You document your work and continuously improve database reliability.

63329f31aeebc7aa.description: About Front End Limited Company Front End Limited Company is an industrial solutions group headquartered in Saudi Arabia, operating across eight integrated verticals including Energy, Industrial Facilities, Geoscience, Space, Offshore, Artificial Intelligence, Autonomy & Mobility, and Mining. The company was recognized as "Innovator of the Year" at the Oil & Gas Middle East 2025 Awards and aligns with Saudi Vision 2030. Role Overview Front End Limited Company is seeking a Project Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role is within the company's Environmental & Sustainability initiatives, an extension of the Industrial Facilities vertical, focusing on delivering circular-economy and decarbonization infrastructure for the Kingdom. The Project Manager will lead the end-to-end delivery of the BST-06 MAX pyrolysis biochar plant at the SBF site in Riyadh, a flagship environmental and sustainability initiative. Key Responsibilities Lead site mobilization, stakeholder onboarding, and baseline confirmation. Direct ground preparation activities, including site clearing, leveling, compaction, and drainage. Oversee foundation design review, concrete slab and equipment plinth construction, and utility trenching. Manage logistics for equipment arrival, customs clearance, transport, and laydown. Direct crane operations, heavy lifting, mechanical assembly, and anchoring of plant components. Coordinate on-site Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) replication and operational commissioning with the supplier team. Verify civil and structural compliance with design intent and HSE requirements. Manage punch lists and close out civil and mechanical snags. Oversee initial operations to confirm safe plant performance within its approved footprint. Manage infrastructure modifications, access road maintenance, containment areas, and ongoing HSE coordination. Lead formal handover to the operations team with full documentation. Complete as-built documentation, lessons-learned register, financial reconciliation, and contractual closeout. Develop and maintain the Project Management Plan, Scope Statement, and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS). Manage change control through a formal change request and approval process. Serve as the primary interface between Front End, the client (SBF), the equipment supplier (Beston Group), and regulatory authorities. Develop and maintain the master construction program (MS Project or Primavera P6) aligned with the June 2026 commissioning target. Track critical-path activities, manage float, and report schedule variance weekly. Manage the project budget; track committed vs. actual cost. Approve subcontractor invoices and variation orders within delegated authority. Report cost performance (CPI/SPI) to the Project Director monthly. Implement Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for civil, structural, and mechanical works. Ensure compliance with KSA building codes, SASO standards, Beston Group specifications, and ISO 9001 quality principles. Conduct daily site inspections; maintain photographic records of all construction milestones. Lead and direct subcontractors engaged in earthworks, concrete, steelwork, mechanical, and utilities installation. Coordinate temporary site services: site office, welfare, security fencing, material storage. Produce weekly progress reports, monthly stakeholder dashboards, and written daily site logs. Chair weekly project coordination meetings and monthly steering committee reviews. Maintain the Project Risk & Issues Register; escalate geotechnical, structural, regulatory, or schedule risks promptly. Develop mitigation plans for high-priority risks; review register weekly. Manage subcontractor contracts, scope, and performance. Coordinate with the supplier (Beston Group) on warranty, spares, and technical support obligations. Liaise with Saudi authorities for site permits, environmental operating licenses, and industrial area compliance. Coordinate with SBF facilities management on power supply, access routes, water/drainage tie-ins, and waste management. Manage client relationships and expectations throughout the lifecycle. Ensure all site activities comply with KSA municipal environmental regulations and SBF site-specific HSE requirements. Oversee lifting plans, toolbox talks, permit-to-work systems, and incident reporting. Champion sustainability outcomes consistent with the project's environmental mission. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated leadership and decision-making capabilities under pressure. Experience in stakeholder management across multicultural and multi-organizational teams. Proficiency in problem-solving and conflict resolution. Strong commercial and contractual awareness. Commitment to safety and environmental stewardship. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Authorities Approve site-level technical decisions within the scope of the approved design. Approve subcontractor work and variations within delegated financial authority. Stop-work authority on any HSE or quality non-conformance. Escalate scope, schedule, cost, or risk exceptions to the Project Director. Project Context This project involves the design, civil construction, installation, commissioning, and operational handover of a pyrolysis biochar production unit. The plant will divert organic and agricultural residues from landfill, produce biochar for soil regeneration and carbon sequestration, and generate renewable syngas as a process energy source. It will operate within KSA municipal environmental regulations and SBF site-specific HSE standards. The project also serves as a reference deployment for Front End's broader sustainability portfolio.
